notes.title: Nerial's new experimental Reality TV game is available now!
notes.content:
[h3]It's the pilot episode of 1999's hottest reality TV show, The Crush House! [/h3]

Cast, film, and produce the show for maximum drama while balancing what the audience wants to see and what the talent needs from you. If you don't get CANCELLED, you might even discover the secrets behind the house's plastic veneer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/b2f5074f8b2be54d518bf42e76ba54fb67ec909f.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/5b65480a11a7c5723ccb9f2bb8314b6d21e552f9.gif[/img]

have tried to make something experimentally silly and still fun. We think that The Crush House is unlike anything we've made before and any other game. You may find that the procedural dialogue system and the need to balance audience thirsts is Reigns-esque. Since this is live television, you'll find lots of product placement from familiar games. 

It has been a long journey since the first Reigns game 8 years ago, and we want to thank you for being a part of it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337820/The_Crush_House/
